Would you like to be an engineer who builds the systems that power advertising at scale, rather than one who just operates them? Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brands, agencies, and publishers. Within Amazon Ads, the SupplyTech organization builds and operates a suite of supply-side systems and the infrastructure that connects publisher inventory to advertiser demand. Our systems process billions of advertising queries every day, where latency, reliability, and quality translate directly into publisher revenue and customer trust.

We are looking for a Senior System Development Engineer, operating as a Site Reliability Engineer, to raise the reliability bar for SupplyTech's most critical, high-throughput production systems. This is a senior individual-contributor role that blends deep software engineering with operational ownership: you will design and build the automation, tooling, and self-healing systems that keep supply-side services reliable at massive scale — and you will set the reliability strategy that multiple teams build against.

You will own and monitor service-level objectives for business-critical systems, lead the engineering response to complex, high-severity issues and drive systemic elimination of operational toil. You will influence the operability of new services before they launch and act as a force multiplier.

Key job responsibilities
Own the reliability, availability, and performance of business-critical PubTech services end-to-end — including SLO/SLA definition, error budgets, and the operational roadmap.

- Design and build automation frameworks, tooling, and self-healing mechanisms (primarily in Python, Java, or Go) that eliminate entire classes of operational toil across teams.
- Lead root-cause analysis for complex, high-severity incidents across the ad-serving pipeline; implement durable long-term fixes and drive correction-of-error (COE) processes to prevent recurrence.

- Design and implement scalable monitoring, alarming, telemetry, and diagnostic solutions for complex distributed systems operating under real-time latency constraints.

- Define and drive operational readiness reviews for new services and features, embedding reliability, observability, and operability standards before launch.
- Partner with software development teams to build a durable runbook and knowledge base.

- Mentor and develop engineers — including other senior ICs — raising the technical and operational bar through design reviews, code reviews, and coaching.

Job Summary We are currently seeking qualified individuals to operate and maintain the power generating facility located at the P.L. Bartow Combined Cycle Power Plant in St. Petersburg, Florida. Must be able to monitor continuous control process in both a control room environment and physical plant inspection to insure the normal operation of the plant. Must be able make necessary equipment adjustments, log significant observations, record daily meter readings and maintain daily operating logs. Must also be able to understand basic chemistry and perform laboratory water analysis. Incumbent will be required to perform all maintenance progression-level tasks associated with the maintenance of the combustion turbines, steam turbine, HRSGs and the associated balance of plant equipment. Job Description:

REPORTS TO: Vice President, Blizzard Communications

YOUR MISSION

The Senior Director of International Communications for Blizzard will lead franchise, brand, and reputation communications across international markets (EMEA, LATAM, APAC), acting as the senior strategic leader for the international communications organization and the connective tissue between global strategy and regional execution. This role shapes how players, creators, and media around the world experience and talk about Blizzard's franchises throughout the year, translating global narratives into cohesive market plans, campaigns, and moments that land with cultural credibility in Europe, Asia, Latin America, and beyond.

Operating with autonomy as the international communications lead for Blizzard, the Senior Director sets direction across launches, live service momentum, franchise storytelling, and community engagement, while driving operational excellence and cross functional alignment at scale. A defining part of the role is judgment: evaluating where the highest impact communications opportunities sit across a broad portfolio of markets and moments, choosing what to invest in, knowing what to leave on the table and driving clarity and alignment on the approach. This role is a key connector across global comms, international marketing and publishing, development teams, legal, and customer support, and a trusted voice in the most visible and most sensitive moments for the business internationally.

This is a people leadership role first. You will lead, coach, and grow a distributed team of regional communications leaders across time zones and cultures, setting a clear vision, raising the creative bar, and creating the conditions for seasoned operators to do the best work of their careers. We are looking for someone thoughtful and strategic, with the creative instinct to imagine communications work no one has seen before and the discipline to make it real across many markets at once.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the international communications strategy for Blizzard franchises, brand, and reputation, ensuring player first, culturally relevant storytelling that is aligned to global strategy and business priorities in every region.

• Evaluate and prioritize the highest impact communications opportunities across markets, moments, and franchises, making clear recommendations about where to invest and where to decline.

• Serve as an embedded communications partner to regional marketing and publishing, development teams, legal, and customer support, influencing plans, timing, and execution rather than reacting to them.
• Protect and strengthen brand reputation internationally, leading issues management with sound judgment, identifying risk early, developing recommendations, and partnering closely with global and regional stakeholders.
• Partner with agencies across regions with clear direction and accountability, ensuring high quality delivery, strong judgment, and measurable results against goals.
• Drive measurement, reporting, and insights, using performance data and learnings to inform optimization, investment decisions, and future planning across markets.
• Manage international communications budget, including forecasting, spend tracking, headcount planning, and resource prioritization.
• Represent international communications with confidence and clarity in senior leadership, regional, and cross functional forums, and bring the voice of players in market back into global planning.
• Partner strategically with marketing and the business on emerging markets approach.

PLAYER PROFILE

Minimum Requirements

• Extensive experience in communications, public relations, creator relations, or a closely related field, including significant time leading communications across multiple international markets. 12+ years in communications or public relations, including 5+ years leading and developing teams, and significant experience across international markets.
• Willingness to work out of Blizzard HQ in Irvine, California. 3 days a week in office.

• Demonstrated success building and executing brand, franchise, or product communications strategies in markets such as Europe, Asia, and Latin America, with an understanding of how one narrative has to flex by culture and media landscape.
• Deep media, creator, and influencer relationships, and the credibility to counsel senior spokespeople and prepare them for high visibility moments.
• Experience leading issues and crisis communications for a consumer brand, with the judgment to know what to escalate, what to answer, and what to let pass.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including editing, message development, and the ability to turn complex information into a story people want to read.
• Strong strategic thinking paired with operational rigor, comfortable owning budgets, agency rosters, planning calendars, and measurement.
• Ability to work across a large, matrixed organization and to build trust quickly with partners in other functions and other time zones.
• Willingness to travel internationally and to work across time zones with regional teams and partners.

Extra Points

• Familiarity with Blizzard franchises and the communities around them.
• Experience communicating around live service titles, seasonal content, and long running franchises.

OUR WORLD

Best known for iconic video game universes including Warcraft, Overwatch, Diablo, and StarCraft, we’ve been creating genre-defining games for millions of players around the world for more than 30 years. We’re on a quest: bring our dreams to life and craft the most epic entertainment experiences…ever. Hard work, iteration and polish go into the Blizzard “secret recipe,” but the most important ingredients come from talented people who share our vision. If that sounds like you, join us.

The videogame industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners.

The US Expansion Construction team leads the design and construction of large-scale semiconductor manufacturing facilities in the United States. This role ensures alignment with technical standards, regulatory compliance, and operational readiness, with transition into sustaining engineering support post-commissioning. Coordinate with design firms, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure system performance, integration, and on-time delivery. Job Description: Role Overview As a Software Engineer on the ESXi OS Services team, you will lead the design and delivery of high-impact functionality across User Space OS services, container services, distributed control planes, and application infrastructure. You will help define technical direction for enterprise-class virtualization, Kubernetes platforms, and modern cloud-native workloads. Key Responsibilities Design and implement advanced operating system techniques for managing virtual systems on x86 architectures. Architect and develop scalable container services, container runtimes, and Kubernetes platform capabilities tightly integrated with ESXi and vSphere. Develop highly available platform infrastructure to run customer workloads that span across clusters and zones, supporting their specific network and storage requirements. Maintain open source code for security fixes, and upkeep upstream Kubernetes features. Drive development of platforms supporting SaaS, CaaS, and FaaS workloads. Partner closely with Product Management to define requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions. Collaborate with UI/UX designers, system architects, test teams, and cross-functional stakeholders across the organization to deliver high-quality, end-to-end solutions. Success in the Role Deliver robust, scalable OS, container services, and Kubernetes platform features on a regular release cadence, providing incremental and measurable customer value. ​​Design and architect solutions with stakeholder buy-in, proactively incorporating feedback to iteratively refine and improve designs. Tackle complex engineering challenges while maintaining high standards for quality, performance, and reliability through effective cross-functional collaboration. Requirements (must have) BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science/Electrical Engineering or similar fields. 5+ years of relevant experience for BS, 3+ for MS and 0+ for PhD. Strong proficiency in C/C++, Golang, and Python. Deep understanding of Linux/Unix operating system internals, especially user space concepts like processes, threads, memory management, and I/O. History of leading System software projects/teams. Experience architecting distributed software solutions. Experience in developing, debugging, and optimizing core operating system services or user space applications. Familiarity with cloud-native technologies, containerization (Docker/containerd), and Kubernetes architecture. Good verbal and written communication skills. —---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Why will you enjoy this new opportunity? You have an analytical mind and a passion for the craft of software engineering, and you love solving problems and learning new things. You are looking for an opportunity to work for a company whose software is utilized by every Fortune 500 company with profound impact across all industries. You want to be part of a collaborative team that cares about the product they build, how they create it, and the impact it has on achieving customers' business goals. The foundation of VMWare by Broadcom's virtualization technology is the ESXi hypervisor. ESXi is an operating system and virtualization infrastructure built from scratch for the explicit purpose of running virtual machines. It is the leading data center operating system in the world, and is used by most large corporations, due to its advanced capabilities, security, performance, and quality. ESXi OS Services team is responsible for all User Space aspects of the ESXi OS. This includes various operating system services, distributed control plane, container runtime and application infrastructure. You will be a hands-on Principal Software Engineer setting direction for high-impact and/or long-range strategic and technical projects. You will lead major initiatives and work with various cross-functional teams to design and deliver new functionality, targeted for distributed control planes, container runtime and new virtualization workloads. Success in the Role: What are the performance outcomes you will work toward completing? You will design and develop novel operating system techniques and algorithms for managing virtual systems in x86 architecture, developing platforms to deploy SaaS, CaaS and FaaS. You will implement advanced container runtime and Kubernetes features, with emphasis on scalability, performance, reliability, and support of upstream open-source technologies. You will work with multiple engineering teams to architect, design, implement and deliver new products based on the enterprise-class vSphere virtualization platform. You will learn the tools and processes necessary to become a successful OS Services engineer. An ideal candidate would be one who thrives in an extremely fast paced development environment and likes tackling complex technical challenges.
